name: evolution-model-lab
description: A local-first workspace for iterative AI-assisted creature design.

scripts.build:packages: corepack pnpm --filter @eml/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/database build && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/prompt-builder build && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/image-processing build && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/core build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm dev:server" "corepack pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:mcp: node -e "console.error('MCP server is scheduled for Milestone 8 and is not implemented yet.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.inspect:mcp: node -e "console.error('MCP inspection is scheduled for Milestone 8.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/server typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/web typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:packages && vitest run --configLoader runner
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm build:packages && tsx tests/e2e/global-setup.ts && playwright test
scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/web build
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @eml/database db:migrate
